# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM backport**

## Highlights

Backports the Apple 26.0 library TFM update and a WinUI .NET 9 fix to the 3.x line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library TFMs backported** — Brings the unversioned app / 26.0 library target-framework split from the v4 line back to 3.119.x for consumers who haven't upgraded yet. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL missing for .NET 9** — Fixes a WinUI Projection DLL not being found when consumed from .NET 9 apps. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
